verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents agent-oriented entry points: a live llms.txt (probe confirmed), an official MCP server, and prompt-to-video endpoints (POST /v3/models/videos). Webhooks cover job notifications, and a profile endpoint returns credit balance, which only lets an agent infer cost from balance changes. Job-status polling, asset download/retrieval and per-job cost reporting are not evidenced, and the OpenAPI spec paths all return 404. missing for 10: documented job-status polling endpoint, documented asset fetch/download URL, per-job cost or credits-consumed reporting, a reachable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the loop
